_note: The three Baidu downloads showed the Queen Elizabeth National Park entrance sign, not the airport. The kept picture is embedded in the UCAA's official ESIA report for the Arua aerodrome expansion (July 2025) — the aerodrome's fire/rescue vehicle by its garage; the rest of that report's photographs are maps, vegetation surveys and signature sheets.
